newsitem.title: USA: Innovo sees projected losses in Q1 and Q2.
newsitem.headline: Innovo sees projected losses in Q1 and Q2.

text.p: Innovo Group Inc said it has projected losses for its first and second quarters of 1997 in a conference call with brokers and analysts.

The company also projected that 70 percent of its 1997 sales would come in the second half of the year, as compared with 54 percent in the second half of fiscal 1996, and therefore, the second half of the year would be key to the company's overall 1997 results.
Innovo said the projected losses in the first and second quarters would reflect the expense of developing the new Warner and Disney license product lines. The licenses were secured in late 1996.
The company also said that the loss in the second quarter would be consistent with the seasonality of the its sales.
Innovo manufactures and markets fashion and utility totes and bags.
